Runs.RunText: FIM District Battle Creek Event presented by BlueOval Battery Park
A student representative from the teams listed on this report must explicitly accept or decline to join the BACKUP pool by placing their initials in the corresponding column.
If a Team declined another Team's invitation during the Alliance Selection process, they MUST indicate "Decline" on this receipt.

Per Game Manual Section 11.6.3.2: After the top ranked ALLIANCE has made their final pick during ALLIANCE Selection, the lead queuer (or their designee) polls the remaining eligible teams. In rank order, the lead queuer (or their designee) will invite remaining teams to accept or decline a position in the BACKUP POOL, i.e. the group of teams willing and able to join an ALLIANCE during the Playoff MATCHES, if needed, until up to 8 teams accept.
